items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: I had played with Woody Herman and Gene Krupa’s bands for, well Gene for about four years

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about your work with the Basie band. Can you tell us about the sound or the feel of that rhythm section? Because everybody says they like that rhythm section, that was the rhythm section, the big band rhythm section.

Yeah, well anytime I ever do high school and college clinics, I always tell them to listen to the Basie band, well the whole band, but particularly the rhythm section. It’s just an example of the way it’s supposed to go, I mean in that type of music anyway. And I remember during the period that we played with them, we were normally recording at the A&R Studio on 48th Street, which was a very small room, probably about half as big as this room, and the whole band in there, and the time was so precise you know. And…
Kind of it counts up like we ain’t really working or this ain’t hard?
